answer: A farm cannot fake the aggregate without controlling every key it names, thus paying the knoll bond on all of them and exposing each to the haven slash. Attestations are aggregated into one signature over 11 distinct keys, and the aggregate must verify against each key's registered public value. Because the dune audit verifies the aggregate, a single forged member invalidates the whole batch. A 360 account operation therefore ties up 34 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
